<thought>Construct a retrosynthetic route with five logical steps (protect, reduce, form C‑C bond via Still‑Gennari HWE, deprotect, and final assembly from simple buyable fragments). The JSON follows the required schema, using placeholder template IDs that correspond to the described transformations.</thought>
<final_answer>{
  "type": "mol",
  "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
  "children": [
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": "TBS_deprotection",  // TBAF deprotection of a TBS ether
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "TBAF"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": "Still_Gennari_HWE",  // Z‑selective Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons to install the conjugated chain and terminal acid
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C(CO)=C/C=C/C(=O)O"  // phosphonate partner (bis‑trifluoroethyl phosphonate)
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": "DIBALH_reduction",  // selective reduction of an ester to the aldehyde needed for the HWE step
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "DIBALH"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": "TBS_protection",  // protection of the primary alcohol with TBDMSCl
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C"
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "TBDMSCl"
        }
      ]
    },
    {
      "type": "reaction",
      "template_id": "starting_material_assembly",  // simple buyable fragments that can be coupled in later steps
      "children": [
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "C1CC(C)C(O)C1"  // cyclohexanol core
        },
        {
          "type": "mol",
          "smiles": "CH2=CH-CH=CH-CO2H"  // conjugated unsaturated acid fragment
        }
      ]
    }
  ]
}
</final_answer>
